cuts.placeText: an antique shop — glass cabinets of old coins and trinkets, a brass scale, a rolltop desk and a velvet armchair
cuts.scene: she is a jewelry specialist sitting elegantly in the velvet armchair with her ankles crossed, mulling over an appraisal
cuts.outfit: an antique dealer look fitted to her body — a fitted velvet vest over a collared blouse and a short skirt with a brooch, bare legs, a large pearl brooch
